name: labs/burhankarahasan__thorlabs-pico
title: Pi Pico W stepper rotation axis (stepper_controller.PicoStepperController)
intro: Pi Pico W stepper rotation axis (stepper_controller.PicoStepperController), adapted from burhankarahasan/thorlabs-pico. It reads `current_rps` and `position_steps`; sets `target_rps`; runs `stop_motion`, `enable_motor`, `disable_motor` and `set_ramp_rate`. `stop_motion`: stop all motion on the resource with a declared deceleration profile and report the stopping position. This capability is always cancellable=false and is exempt from rate limiting. A hardware driver: the market serves its fake backend, so no instrument is needed.
